verdict.rationale: Spline documents reusable Components whose instances stay linked to the main component and update automatically when it changes. That covers the reuse and linked-to-source parts of the story. The pack has no evidence of component variants or per-instance overrides, so about half the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented component variants, documented per-instance overrides that preserve the link, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source

citations.quote: Components are objects that can be reused multiple times throughout your scene and whenever there are changes made to the main component all instances will update accordingly.
